annotations.title: Set or remove the GolfCore API monthly cap

description: Starter and Pro have no monthly cap by default: requests past the included amount are billed at the plan's overage rate without limit. This tool sets an optional cap, after which requests are refused until the month resets, or removes it when units is null. A cap starts at the plan's included requests (read them from api_account). Confirm the number and what it could cost with the person first.

units.description: Monthly request cap, or null for no cap.
